donate.title: Help Change the World
donate.bodyP1: Changing the world is a huge goal, so we must start off the best we can. Though we currently have no live Kickstarter projects, please be on the lookout for any of our upcoming fundraising campaigns.
donate.bodyP2: By donating, you'll be able to help us support our employees, cover publishing costs, pay fees for resources like this website, trademarks, and copyright, and meet other financial necessities. We're immensely grateful of your generosity!

about.title: WE ARE GEONOVA
about.bodyP1: Founded in January of 2020, GeoNova Gaming has one goal which sets us apart from any other video game company out there. Our mission is simple: to change the world for the better. The world is constantly changing, adapting; even the way it changes, well, changes.
about.bodyP2: Humans have always been telling stories and passing them down, teaching younger generations important values and morals, which in turn shaped the beginning of society. Since then, we've evolved from the spoken word, to the written one. Shakespeare, Thoreau, Austen, WOolf, and server other authors, would create worlds with the power of ink and paper. Then we evolved further into the visual portrayal of these worlds, using cinema, TV, and other media platforms to cpativate audiences with storytelling. Do you remember the adventures and stories as a child, the countless of life lessons and wise words spoken from certain characters? We do.

artistSection1.name: Naomi Hopton
artistSection1.description: I'm a 3D modeller and digital artist. My dream is to be a tiny woodland creature in a fantasy land, but since that wish hasn't been granted yet, drawing them will do for now.

artistSection2.name: Ryan Pedder
artistSection2.description: I am an artist that is enthusiastic about telling a story through the art of the game. I’ve enjoyed playing games since I was young, but never thought about how they were made until much later. Once I learnt about the process of creating games, I fell down the rabbit hole and I am still falling.

artistSection3.name: Naimishaba “Nimi” Parmar
artistSection3.description: Howdy! I’m a 3D modeling artist and a proud graduate from Texas A&M. I love to visualize unique characters and interesting environments.

coderSection1.name: Tam Nguyen
coderSection1.description: I’m an enthusiastic game developer/programmer who’s love for how games are made led to leading a department of like-minded individuals. I pride myself on being understanding of my team's needs while ensuring we stay on track.

coderSection2.name: Carl Antoine
coderSection2.description: I am family-orientated and love helping out when I can. I'm a software developer and like to make games.

coderSection3.name: Daniel Rodriguez
coderSection3.description: Been in love with video games since the age of 3. I play fighting games competitively, mostly Ultimate Marvel vs. Capcom 3! Best Magneto player in FL and 5th place at CEOtaku!.

coderSection4.name: India “Indō” Franklin
coderSection4.description: I'm a creative and driven person who loves building strong connections and coming up with innovative ideas to create great results for our clients and team. 'Dreams didn't make us kings. Dragons did' - Daemon Targaryen.
coderSection4.favoritegame: REV, Dead By Daylight, Animal Crossing.

coderSection5.name: Paul Howard
coderSection5.description: I started my gaming adventure on old DOS games, and never lost my love for the craft. Now, I work on coding them myself!.

coderSection6.name: Steffan Watts
coderSection6.description: My passion for games and the creative nature involved in making them began at an early age. So now being able to use my skills and take my own creative ideas and turn them into a reality so that I can share with people is really an amazing experience.
coderSection6.favoritegame: Assassin's Creed Ezio Series, Uncharted Series, Witcher 3.

coderSection7.name: Brandon Johnston
coderSection7.description: I’m an aspiring game developer from Middle Tennessee. I’m also a two time published creative fiction author.

coderSection8.name: Anthony Ferdin
coderSection8.description: I’m an aspiring game developer from Middle Tennessee. I’m also a two time published creative fiction author.

coderSection9.name: Cameron Ghaemmaghami
coderSection9.description: Graduate from California that can solve FizzBuzz like no one else. Video games bring me great joy and anger. I program things that produce the former, but doing so produces the latter.
coderSection9.favoritegame: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt, Fire Emblem.

writersSection1.name: Alunaria Verano
writersSection1.description: Hello my name is Alunaría, I am GeoNova’s Lead Writer.

writersSection2.name: Michael “Zaku” Nutt
writersSection2.description: Influenced by games at a young age, I strive to create stories that envelope the audience and leave them desolate when it's over.

writersSection3.name: Gracie “Pantaloons” Todd
writersSection3.description: I’m a director and writer specializing in all things silly and sometimes spooky. With a diverse portfolio in both live-action and animation, including a popular children’s series, a co-written horror feature currently in post-production, and ongoing work as a comedy writer for a video game. I excel in all things delightfully dumb that shows my out-of-the-box thinking and surreal style.

bardSection1.name: Michelle Lugo
bardSection1.role: Music composer / Sound Designer / Audio Implementer
bardSection1.description: I'm a music composer, sound designer, and audio implementer from Puerto Rico. I'm passionate about games and how they sound. I love creating sound for fantasy and sci-fi worlds, from feeling like you're flying to giving motivation during a battle; sound is my weapon to evoke these feelings.

bardSection2.name: David Rubenstein
bardSection2.description: I’m a retired ocean physicist, who spent a lot of time on board ships deploying instruments, and hoping to get them back. Nowadays I spend my time composing memorable music for video games, films and TV.

bardSection3.name: Rachel Williams
bardSection3.description: I'm a film and video game composer passionate about bringing stories to life through music. Outside of the studio, you can find me immersed in the world of video games!.

bardSection4.name: Joshua Brazil
bardSection4.description: Hello there! My name is Josh and I'm a composer. I started with playing guitar and piano as a kid. My passion for music, video games and film led me to pursue a career creating immersive soundtracks for interactive experiences.

marketersSection1.name: Rosy Travis
marketersSection1.description: I’m a digital artist from Southern California who loves film, music, games, and art. I personally believe there’s nothing a bluetooth speaker and a good playlist can’t fix.

marketersSection2.name: Carolina Carralero
marketersSection2.description: Hi! I'm Carolina! I am GeoNova Gaming's Video Editing Marketer! I enjoy editing, singing, dancing and learning languages! I'm currently learning Korean and relearning Spanish!

marketersSection3.name: Sara Gennevee Alvarez
marketersSection3.description: Hi everyone! My name is Sara and I am determined to be that one women strutting in the city with a suit and tie, high heels on, briefcase on the side, going up the mountains to my cabin next to a mini farm!.

externalsSection1.name: Nico Gutiérrez
externalsSection1.role: Mechatronic Engineer / Fullstack Web Developer / Software Developer / Computer Technician

externalsSection2.name: Guilherme 'Badger' Inácio
externalsSection2.description: Olá, I'm a human that’s been passionate about arts & crafts since I was around 5 years old, always inspired by any soothing fantasy music. I've always loved drawing and modeling living beings, from real animals to mythical creatures.
externalsSection2.favoritegame: TESV: Skyrim, Fable 2 and The Witcher 3.
